invariants: Exactly 24 production project sentinels are present.
The final wpfgfx project plus 23 static-library projects form the currently frozen project lower bound.
This group does not replace physical-file or multi-view closure.
readinessRule: Every project sentinel has all checkedCategories closed and all direct project/supply references resolved.
doneRule: All member project sentinels are Accepted and the production denominator is deterministically computable.

invariants: Model, schema, generator, frozen outputs and consumers remain separately traceable.
No regeneration result may overwrite frozen outputs before differential review.
readinessRule: All physical inputs, generator components, frozen outputs and consumers have Ledger records.
doneRule: Isolated regeneration and semantic/full-text differential evidence satisfy the group requirements.

invariants: Native and managed generated type layouts derive from the same traced family.
Signed-in generated outputs remain physical records.
readinessRule: Compat inputs, generator fragments, frozen outputs and all native/managed consumers are enumerated.
doneRule: Cross-architecture native/managed size, offset, enum and protocol evidence passes.

invariants: Native and managed AV type layouts derive from the same traced family.
readinessRule: All inputs, outputs and consumers are enumerated.
doneRule: Cross-architecture native/managed layout and protocol evidence passes.

invariants: wpfgfx.def is preprocessed to the linker-consumed wpfgfx.i.
Static declarations do not substitute for actual PE export evidence.
readinessRule: Preprocessing conditions and output identity are recorded.
doneRule: Candidate linker input and actual export manifest match the approved ABI manifest.

invariants: Version, ETW and shader resources retain stable type/name/language/content semantics.
Static resource inputs do not substitute for actual PE resource enumeration.
readinessRule: All resource inputs, generated outputs and transport paths are enumerated.
doneRule: Candidate resource manifest matches approved original baselines for all required configurations and architectures.

invariants: DEF, native definitions, managed declarations and actual binaries remain separate fact layers.
106/107/99/8/7 are static baseline counts pending machine-manifest reproduction.
No production export is added before its implementation work package and evidence gates.
readinessRule: ABI entries, managed declarations, native definitions and original binary observations cross-link to Ledger IDs.
doneRule: All required entries are accepted with architecture-specific calling convention, layout, caller and binary evidence.

invariants: The source cycle remains traceable and is not removed by a new abstraction.
Only original-name type/signature/layout scaffolds may break implementation ordering.
readinessRule: Member physical files and generated protocol dependencies are enumerated.
doneRule: All members satisfy their required evidence without unapproved architectural deviation.

invariants: SW, HW and AV source responsibilities and back-references remain traceable.
The cycle is not replaced with a new rendering architecture during equivalence migration.
readinessRule: Member physical files, COM/platform dependencies and external supplies are enumerated.
doneRule: All members satisfy differential, lifecycle, resource and integration evidence.
